content: 10015.io is a mixed consumer/dev kitchen sink (case, password, QR, lorem, image tools) with ads/extension; transform.tools is conversion-heavy (Markdown to HTML among many codecs), not a light-utility catalog. TinyWow-style upload/image/PDF suites are explicitly out of scope. Devtoolbox should match it-tools depth per tool, not 10015 breadth.
